note: Warsh-authored English + Urdu glosses for the Quranic Core 500. Nothing here is taken from hafiz-quran.com: that page's English is broken (a bad find-and-replace ate the letters 'go') and most of its glosses translate one ayah rather than defining the word. headword is the dictionary form we store; where it differs from the source list, sourceForm records what the source had. Verbs are glossed as English infinitives. Merge with Docs/data/quranic-core-500.json (rank, freq, pos, flags) to build seed rows.
